rules.intro: Each rule adjusts the reference price of a night. “Add” rules add up; of the “Maximum” rules only the biggest adjustment counts.
rules.emptyHint: Create a rule by occupancy, lead time, weekday, holidays or events: the next run will use it.

kindHints.occupancy: Up or down depending on how much of the night is already sold.
kindHints.lead_time: Last-minute discounts or a price for booking early.
kindHints.day_of_week: A fixed adjustment for some days of the week.
kindHints.holiday: Colombian holidays and their long weekends.
kindHints.event: The nights of an event that moves demand.

rules.deleteHint: Pending recommendations are recalculated on the next run.

editor.description: The adjustment applies to the reference price of each night (season or default price).
editor.name: Name
editor.tiersHint: “From” is included and “to” is not; a tier ending at 100 % includes the sold-out night.
editor.leadHint: The tightest window applies: the fewest days for last minute, the most days for booking early.
editor.daysHint: Leave blank the days without an adjustment.
editor.includeBridgesHint: The Saturday and Sunday nights before a Monday holiday.
editor.combineStackHint: Its adjustment adds up with the other “Add” rules.
editor.combineMaxHint: Of the “Maximum” rules that apply to a night only the biggest adjustment counts.
editor.priorityHint: Orders the list and breaks ties between “Maximum” rules with the same adjustment.
editor.previewHint: Works out what a run would leave now with this rule, without saving anything.
editor.previewResult_one: A run now would leave {{count}} recommendation ({{upDown}}), average change {{avg}}, impact {{impact}}.
editor.previewResult_other: A run now would leave {{count}} recommendations ({{upDown}}), average change {{avg}}, impact {{impact}}.
editor.previewNone: A run now would leave no recommendations.

errors.earlyAfterLastMinute: Must start after the last-minute windows
errors.needOneDay: Set the adjustment of at least one day
errors.eventDates: The last night cannot be before the first one
errors.eventTooLong: An event lasts a year at most
errors.name: Give the rule a name

bounds.intro: No recommendation leaves these bounds, even when its rules ask for more. They are set per category in each base plan.
bounds.empty: There are no active base plans with categories.
bounds.needOne: Set a floor, a ceiling or both
bounds.order: The ceiling cannot be lower than the floor

settings.title: Revenue settings
settings.enabledHint: The rules run on their own at 05:00, 11:00, 17:00 and 23:00.
settings.autoApplyHint: Every run writes the recommended prices to the grid without waiting for approval.
settings.autoApplyConfirm: From the next run on, the prices of the grid will change on their own, within the bounds and the daily change cap. Every change stays in the history and in the audit log, where it can be undone.
settings.horizonHint: How many nights ahead each run checks (7 to 365).
settings.maxChangeHint: How much the price of a night can move in one day (1 to 100).
settings.minChangeHint: Smaller changes are not recommended (0 to 50).
settings.roundingHint: Recommended prices are rounded to this multiple; $ 0 = no rounding.
settings.readOnly: Only people who manage revenue can change these settings.
